verified_facts.text: Sense, A Rosewood Spa overlooks the Sir Francis Drake Channel from a cliffside setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Sir Francis Drake Channel, Sense, A Rosewood Spa embodies the rejuvenating essence of its cliffside environment.

verified_facts.text: The property is considered one of the first eco-resorts and has kept that commitment throughout its 60-year history.
verified_facts.excerpt: Considered to be one of the first eco-resorts, the property has upheld this commitment throughout its 60-year legacy.

verified_facts.excerpt: Honoring Little Dix Bay's original tree houses, these residences enjoy wraparound beach views and indoor-outdoor rain showers for elevated elegance.

verified_facts.text: The One-Bedroom Pool Suite comes with its own pool, ocean views and a furnished patio.

verified_facts.text: The rooms are airy cottages set among gardens just steps from the beach.

verified_facts.text: Reef House, steps from the sand, uses fresh local produce from the resort's own farm.
